payload.reason: The evidence describes a meta-learning algorithm that utilizes a Meta-LSTM architecture for multi-task learning, which captures shared knowledge across tasks.

claims.text: The algorithm used is a Meta-LSTM, which serves as a meta network to share knowledge across multiple tasks.
The Meta-LSTM captures meta knowledge that can be transferred to new tasks, improving performance on unseen tasks.
The architecture consists of a basic network for task-specific predictions controlled by the shared meta network.
